svg.aria-label: caddy-forticertsync: Caddy v2 plugin that pushes renewed TLS certificates straight into FortiGate via the FortiOS REST API, rebinds SSL-VPN, admin HTTPS and VIPs to the new cert and cleans up the old one. No cron, no polling.
